# Larksuite

> Larksuite is an all-in-one unified communication and productivity platform combining team chat, documents, meetings, and business tools.

Larksuite provides an integrated workspace for teams to communicate, collaborate, and manage work through a single platform. The suite includes Messenger for instant communication, Docs for content creation, Base for data management, Meetings for video conferencing, and additional tools like Calendar, Email, Wiki, and OKR tracking.

## Key Topics

- Lark Messenger
- Team Chat
- Unified Communication
- All-in-One Platform
- Business Collaboration
- Instant Messaging
- Productivity Hub
- Lark Docs
- Lark Base
- Lark Meetings
- AI Meeting Notes
- Free Tier
- Approval Workflows
- Wiki
- OKR Management

## Core Communication

- [Lark Messenger](https://www.larksuite.com/en_us/product/messenger): Unified team chat platform with tool integration and productivity features for free all-in-one web business communication
